top_buys.pitch: FTC meeting signals the UniFirst deal faces a real antitrust fight.
top_buys.why: Cintas and UniFirst executives were set to meet with the FTC on Friday, a step that typically signals regulators have serious concerns about a combination of the two largest uniform rental firms. A long review or a block removes a growth lever investors had begun to assume. Antitrust risk tends to grind on the acquirer's valuation gradually rather than all at once.
top_buys.risks: A quick regulatory green light would send the stock the other way; Cintas is a quality compounder with sticky revenue.
top_buys.watch: Any FTC second-request news or statements from either company about deal timing.

top_buys.pitch: Anthropic's IPO quietly validates a $47B Azure commitment and a profitable Microsoft stake.
top_buys.why: Microsoft's $1B placement in Anthropic is up on paper and the bigger prize is a seven-year, $47.2B cloud commitment that underpins Azure growth. BofA also reiterated a buy on the Copilot enterprise path. Microsoft fell with the AI group, which may be giving back value the Anthropic contract actually adds.
top_buys.risks: If the AI capex backlash deepens, even contracted revenue stories sell off; Microsoft is also spending heavily to serve this demand.
top_buys.watch: Azure growth commentary and any further Anthropic contract detail.
